svg.title: Quarry worker — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as quarry worker, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A broad stone block is split by a narrow downward wedge and one clean zigzag fracture. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
